china_race_dynamics.text: We cannot allow China to dominate the international standards for the technologies of tomorrow. [...] That's why the bipartisan NIST for the Future Act this Committee passed will prioritize NIST's role in supporting U.S. leadership in international standards development.
china_race_dynamics.context: House Science, Space, and Technology Subcommittee hearing on U.S. leadership in technical standards, featuring Member opening statements.

deepseek.reason: The speaker says China must not dominate international standards and endorses prioritizing U.S. leadership through NIST.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The China competition framing is explicit, though the AI connection is implicit in 'technologies of tomorrow.'
